question: 设 $\alpha_1=(2,3,a)^T,\ \alpha_2=(1,-2,4)^T,\ \alpha_3=(3,1,2a+3)^T,\ \alpha_4=(a,1-a,a+2)^T$，已知三维列向量 $\beta$ 与 $\alpha_1,\alpha_2,\alpha_3$ 均正交，且 $\beta^T\alpha_4=1$，则 $\beta=\underline{\qquad}$.
raw_question_text: 设 $\alpha_1=(2,3,a)^T,\ \alpha_2=(1,-2,4)^T,\ \alpha_3=(3,1,2a+3)^T,\ \alpha_4=(a,1-a,a+2)^T$，已知三维列向量 $\beta$ 与 $\alpha_1,\alpha_2,\alpha_3$ 均正交，且 $\beta^T\alpha_4=1$，则 $\beta=\underline{\qquad}$.
